newsitem.title: BELARUS: Seven soldiers killed in Belarus truck crash.
newsitem.headline: Seven soldiers killed in Belarus truck crash.

text.p: Seven conscripts were killed and two were injured when the truck in which they were delivering timber crashed in Belarus, an official said on Monday.

The accident occured on Sunday near Borisov, 80 km east of the capital Minsk when the truck loadded with timber drove into a pothole in the road and tipped over into ditch, said Alexei Taranov, aide to the prosecutor general.
The seven died immediately under the scattered timber. Two other soldiers were injured.
